1018-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-1916-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

116-1662-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-1662-2645-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2921-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2921-5254-6774.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
1123-6495-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

710-3055-4247.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4247-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-6887.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-2557-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-527-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4742-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7156.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4613-4968-6996.description:
Activate The Destined White Mage by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1558-3963-6741.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five multicolored permanents.
Meneldor does not have summoning sickness. An opponent cannot block Meneldor.
1558-3963-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Meneldor, triggering Meneldor, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

2464-4311-5051-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-4311-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2382-5659-6797--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-5659-6797--33.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1357-2492-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-2492-4697.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 4.
1357-2492-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

397-5670-6719.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5670-6719.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2906-2921-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2906-2921-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-2921-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2906-2921-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4067-6608-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6608-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

2060-4222-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2060-4222-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

1878-2634-5049-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-2634-5049-5195.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-2634-5049-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

277-880-6529.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1618-2631-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-2631-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Alrund's Epiphany and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-2631-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Alrund's Epiphany and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Alrund's Epiphany and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Alrund's Epiphany's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-2631-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

1329-2178-3180.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3180.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Chamber Sentry from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Chamber Sentry from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Emry triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2239-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Ardent Elementalist each turn.
2239-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Ardent Elementalist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

802-889-1636-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
802-889-1636-5803.description:
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting any applicable target.
Kitsa's prowess ability and Deekah trigger.
Resolve the Kitsa trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Snap, with the copy targeting any other creature.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
When the Fractal enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning the targeted creature from the battlefield to its owner's hand, and untapping up to two lands.
Repeat from step 4.

5078-5243-5864-6055.easyPrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
5078-5243-5864-6055.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
5078-5243-5864-6055.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

567-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2034-3451-4191-4784.description:
Cast Augusta from your hand by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Augusta, adding {C}{C}.
When Augusta dies, Death's Oasis triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Plargg from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-3327-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2292-3327-4871.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
When Dargo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

224-1671-1772-2653.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1335-2757-2953.notablePrerequisites: Dawn's Reflection attached to a basic land.
1335-2757-2953.description:
Activate the enchanted land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding an additional {2}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature, untapping the enchanted land.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Repeat until Marath has no more +1/+1 counters.
Marath dies due to having 0 toughness and goes to the command zone.
Cast Marath by paying {R}{G}{W} plus commander tax.
Marath enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the amount of mana spent.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Marath any number of times, choosing any value for X.

2156-2232-3273.notablePrerequisites: any other planeswalker on the battlefield.
2156-2232-3273.description:
Use {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice, putting Chandra on to the battlefield.
Return the other planeswalker to hand with the Curio trigger.
Use Chandra's +1 ability to add {R} {R} and deal 2 damage to an opponent.
Use {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice, putting the first planeswalker on to the battlefield.
Return Chandra to hand with the Curio trigger.
